name: stock_search
description: Search Freepik stock catalog by keyword and/or by visual similarity to an existing creation image (imageCreationId; every content type except 3d). content_type accepts several comma-separated resource types in one call. license/ai_generated/orientation/color refine the resource verticals; shape is icons-only and video_type is video-only. Returns items with IDs, titles, types, preview URLs, plus relatedKeywords to refine the query when the results share tags. Use stock_get for full details, stock_download for file URL.

ai_generated.description: only = AI-generated, excluded = no AI. Omit for both. Ignored for icons.

color.description: Dominant colour. Honoured by the resource verticals and by icons, whose endpoint rejects purple and pink — those are dropped there rather than failing the search. Ignored for video and 3d.

content_type.description: Filter by type: photo, vector, illustration, psd, design, video, icon, 3d. "design" is the curated template catalogue. Several of photo/vector/illustration/psd/design can be combined comma-separated in one call (e.g. "photo,vector"); video, icon and 3d must be requested on their own. Omit for all types.

imageBase64.description: Alternative to imageCreationId: the search image itself, JPEG or PNG, base64-encoded and scaled to about 224px on its shortest side. Nothing is stored. Not for 3d.

imageCreationId.description: ID of an existing creation whose image is used for visual similarity search. Valid for every content type except 3d. Can be combined with query.

orientation.description: Image orientation; for video maps to aspect ratio. Ignored for icons.

per_page.description: 1–50. Only honoured for icon and 3d; every other type returns 50 items per page.

query.description: Search keywords. Required unless imageCreationId or imageBase64 is provided; with an image the text refines the visual search.

shape.description: Icons only: the icon style. Ignored for every other content type.

video_type.description: Video only: "template" covers the After Effects, Premiere and MOGRT projects, and returns their rendered MP4. Applied to the results rather than upstream, so a page can come back well under its nominal size. Ignored for every other content type.
